description: Pittsburgh International Airport - Scheduled Passenger Traffic is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Allegheny County Airport Authority. Here you can find Pittsburgh International Airport’s Monthly Scheduled Traffic Reports. Each of these reports contain a year-over-year (YOY) analysis of scheduled flights and available seats. Flights and seats are for the entire month listed and are based solely on departures. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Allegheny County Airport Authority. Its tags are acaa, airport, airport authority, allegheny county airport authority, aviation. It offers 8 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2024-06-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
